issue.title: Bug: [dhcp_relay] test_dhcp_pkt_recv.py fails if ACL_TABLE is full

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

This test hits a known issue ([sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/6323](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/6323)) when the DATA_ACL table is full and cannot add more entries. The suggested fix in mentioned in that issue is to remove the DATA_ACL table for the duration of the test, so that there is enough space for testing. We should check for the DATA_ACL table being present in a pytest fixture, and if it is we should save the state, remove the table, and add the state back at the end of the test.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests/dhcp_relay/test_dhcp_pkt_recv.py with a full DATA_ACL table, it will fail with a slew of SAI errors:
```
2025 Aug 21 <IPV6>.301908 <dut> ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_ACL:_brcm_sai_xgs_field_group_create:221 field group config create failed with bcm error No resources for operation (0xfffffff2).#012!!!

2025 Aug 21 <IPV6>.301908 <dut> ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_ACL:_brcm_sai_acl_xgs_create_table:4545 field group create failed with error -4.

2025 Aug 21 <IPV6>.301908 <dut> ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_ACL:_brcm_sai_create_acl_table_int:812 acl create table failed with error -4.

2025 Aug 21 <IPV6>.301946 <dut> ERR syncd#syncd: :- sendApiResponse: api SAI_COMMON_API_CREATE failed in syncd mode: SAI_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected: Test passes regardless of the state of the DATA_ACL table.

Actual: Test fails when the DATA_ACL table is full.

resolution.title: Issue 21164: [dhcp_relay] Add workaround for ACL limit issue
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
test_dhcp_pkt_recv.py fails when all ACLs have been programmed. We can detect this case and compensate for it by storing the table info and re-instating it at the end of the test.

Closes #21164

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Currently the test requires space in the DATAACL test in order to run, removing that requirement makes the test applicable in a wider range of contexts.

#### How did you do it?

In the test infra, store the contents of the DATAACL table and restore those contents at the end of the test.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Fill the DATAACL table. The run the test. Without this change, the test fails.

With this change, the test passes. I manually verified that the DATAACL table was the same after the test finished.

#### Any platform specific information?

This is seen on Broadcom TH5, but it would be expected in some form or another on any device, since if there is no space for the test ACL tables.
